title: Quasi-coherent cohomology of one-column finite free Hom
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an open, and $E,I$ complexes of module sheaves on the localized site [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Fix $k\in\mathbf Z$. Suppose $E^i=0$ for $i\ne k$, $E^k$ is isomorphic to a finite free module, and every $H^j(I)$ is quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent]. Then every $H^n(\mathcal Hom^\bullet(E,I))$ is quasi-coherent [def-pur-hom-complex].

source.place: Tags 0A6H (2), 08I5; finite-column argument, with finite coproduct closure on the open subscheme.

proof.text: Choose the rank and finite-free isomorphism and apply single_supported_finiteFree_homology_iso to identify H^n(Hom(E,I)) with r copies of H^(k+n)(I).

Transport quasi-coherence to U.toScheme by Scheme.Modules.overEquiv using the continuous equivalence of localized open sites and its unit-module comparison. Its inverse preserves quasi-coherence by the same pushforward-of-left-adjoint theorem. The proved source-library isQuasicoherent_sigma theorem gives quasi-coherence of the finite coproduct of the transported target homology. PreservesCoproduct.iso transports this back across the equivalence. Apply its unit isomorphism and the cohomology isomorphism from step 1. This includes r=0, empty opens and arbitrary target complexes.

lean.statement:
theorem single_supported_finiteFree_hom_qc
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (E I : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (k : ℤ) (hE : ∀ i : ℤ, i ≠ k → IsZero (E.X i))
    (hfree : ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (E.X k ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))
    (hI : ∀ i : ℤ, (I.homology i).IsQuasicoherent) (n : ℤ) :
    ((homComplex (R := X.toRingedSpace.sheaf.over U) E I).homology n).IsQuasicoherent
